style: Use case: illustration-story. One landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for an Australian sailing education website. Naturalistic hand-painted maritime magazine artwork, nuanced human faces, restrained brushwork, natural coastal colours. A fictional educational scene, not a photograph, technical diagram or real school. No text, logos, lettering, watermarks, brand marks or arrows. Anatomically credible hands and plausible sailing equipment. Everyone aboard wears a correctly fitted lifejacket, sensible sun protection for daylight. Calm manageable sailing conditions. No repeated generic white male instructor in a blue shirt. Australia is a multicultural society; faithfully follow the particular people specified, avoid stereotypes. Keep image clear on mobile.
